title: 2022 年 6 月英语六级真题（第 1 套）

analysis.topic: 卢沟桥的历史、石狮与建筑价值
analysis.reference: Located 15 kilometers southwest of Tian'anmen Square and spanning the Yongding River, Lugou Bridge is the oldest existing multi-arch stone bridge in Beijing. Originally built in 1192 and reconstructed in 1698, the bridge is supported by 281 pillars. Each pillar features a stone lion on top. More lions are hidden on the heads, backs, bellies, or paws of these stone lions. Vivid, lifelike, and in a myriad of poses, these stone lions are regarded as masterpieces of the stone carving art of Lugou Bridge. The stone lions on the bridge are too numerous to count, hence a popular saying in the Beijing area goes: "The stone lions on Lugou Bridge are simply uncountable." Lugou Bridge is not only world-renowned for its aesthetic features, but also universally recognized as a milestone in the history of stone bridge architecture.

sentences.cn: 卢沟桥位于天安门广场西南15公里处，横跨永定河，是北京现存最古老的多拱石桥。
sentences.en: Located 15 kilometers southwest of Tian'anmen Square and spanning the Yongding River, Lugou Bridge is the oldest existing multi-arch stone bridge in Beijing.
sentences.structure: 过去分词短语 Located... and spanning... 作状语，主句为主系表结构，简洁地整合三层信息
keys: 多拱石桥 multi-arch stone bridge
现存最古老的 the oldest existing

sentences.cn: 卢沟桥最初建成于1192年，1698年重建，由281根柱子支撑。
sentences.en: Originally built in 1192 and reconstructed in 1698, the bridge is supported by 281 pillars.
sentences.structure: 过去分词短语 Originally built... and reconstructed... 作时间状语，主句用被动语态 is supported by
keys: 最初建成于 originally built in

sentences.cn: 每根柱子上都有一头石狮。
sentences.en: Each pillar features a stone lion on top.
sentences.structure: 简单主谓宾结构，用 features 替代 has 更为生动

sentences.cn: 这些石狮的头、背、腹部或爪子上都藏着更多的狮子。
sentences.en: More lions are hidden on the heads, backs, bellies, or paws of these stone lions.
sentences.structure: 被动语态 are hidden，介词短语 on the heads, backs, bellies, or paws 作地点状语，并列名词注意用逗号和 or 连接

sentences.cn: 这些石狮生动逼真、千姿百态，是卢沟桥石刻艺术的精品。
sentences.en: Vivid, lifelike, and in a myriad of poses, these stone lions are regarded as masterpieces of the stone carving art of Lugou Bridge.
sentences.structure: 形容词短语 Vivid, lifelike, and in a myriad of poses 前置作状语，主句用 be regarded as 表评价
keys: 生动逼真 vivid and lifelike
千姿百态 in a myriad of poses
石刻艺术 stone carving art

sentences.cn: 桥上的石狮不计其数，因而北京地区流传着"卢沟桥上的石狮子——数不清"的说法。
sentences.en: The stone lions on the bridge are too numerous to count, hence a popular saying in the Beijing area goes: "The stone lions on Lugou Bridge are simply uncountable."
sentences.structure: too...to... 结构表示"不计其数"，冒号引出直接引语呈现民间说法，hence 连接因果
keys: 不计其数 too numerous to count
流传着……的说法 a popular saying goes

sentences.cn: 卢沟桥不仅以其美学特征闻名于世，还被公认为石桥建筑史上的一座丰碑。
sentences.en: Lugou Bridge is not only world-renowned for its aesthetic features, but also universally recognized as a milestone in the history of stone bridge architecture.
sentences.structure: not only...but also... 并列结构，两个表语共享系动词 is，形成紧凑的主系表句
keys: 石桥建筑史 the history of stone bridge architecture

pitfalls: 「多拱石桥」漏译 multi-arch，仅写 stone bridge 丢采分点
「横跨」误用 cross，应用 span 表示桥梁跨越河流
「千姿百态」直译为 thousand poses 不地道，应用 a myriad of poses 或 various postures
「丰碑」误译为 monument（实体碑），此处应译为 milestone（里程碑）更贴切
「流传着……的说法」遗漏 saying/folk saying，导致句意不完整

upgrades.plain: Lugou Bridge has a stone lion on each pillar.
upgrades.better: Each pillar features a stone lion on top.
upgrades.note: features 比 has 更具描写感，且以 each pillar 作主语更突出细节

upgrades.plain: These stone lions are vivid and have many different poses.
upgrades.better: Vivid, lifelike, and in a myriad of poses, these stone lions are regarded as masterpieces.
upgrades.note: 前置形容词短语作状语使句式更紧凑高级，a myriad of 替代 many different 更文雅

upgrades.plain: Lugou Bridge is famous in the world for its beauty.
upgrades.better: Lugou Bridge is world-renowned for its aesthetic features.
upgrades.note: world-renowned 比 famous in the world 更地道，aesthetic features 比 beauty 更精准学术

upgrades.plain: It is thought to be an important work in bridge history.
upgrades.better: It is universally recognized as a milestone in the history of stone bridge architecture.
upgrades.note: universally recognized 语气更强，milestone 比 important work 更能体现「丰碑」的分量

upgrades.plain: There are so many lions that people cannot count them.
upgrades.better: The stone lions are too numerous to count, hence a popular saying goes...
upgrades.note: too...to 结构更简练，hence + saying 的衔接体现高级语篇连贯能力
